prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: production sprite atlas for an anatomical construction game. Reference image is style only: luminous cyan hairline contours, translucent living coral/violet tissue, muted gold nerves, ivory bone. Create a 2048x2048 transparent PNG, precisely FOUR columns by FOUR rows, sixteen separate objects, each confined to its own 512x512 cell with at least 45 transparent pixels of margin. No labels, lettering, panels, grid, navy background, circles, frames, pictograms, shadows or badges. Each row numbered here only for layout, do not draw numbers. Every skin layer uses the SAME frontal cut-edge viewpoint, horizontal width 410 px. The assembly represents a small patch of OUTER FOREARM skin with outer surface at top, deeper tissue below; skin cells 20px across. They must align when stacked by a compositor.
Row1 col1: a horizontal strip of several layers of flattened pale violet outer skin cells, width410 height100, living purple basal cells at bottom, WITHOUT lipids, nerves or vessels. Row1 col2: only thin amber lipid seams following the gaps between the SAME flattened cells as col1, width410 height80, no cells. Row1 col3: horizontal deeper dermal supporting tissue block width410 height220, translucent coral mesh of collagen fibres and scattered living fibroblasts, no vessels or nerves or glands. Row1 col4: isolated red and blue branching skin capillary network width390 height170, fine anatomically connected tubes, no skin.
Row2 col1: isolated coiled sweat gland tube 130 wide 95 tall, violet living epithelial wall. Row2 col2: narrow sweat duct 35 wide 245 tall with pore opening at top, same violet living tube. Row2 col3: isolated golden sensory nerve branches width350 height250, several free endings and one small deep pressure corpuscle, no tissue. Row2 col4: small whole right forearm anatomical locator cutaway, elbow above wrist, little rectangular cyan inspection marking on outer mid forearm; arm 110wide 300tall.
Row3 col1: a rough short metallic edge capable of nicking skin, tangible fragment, 220wide. Row3 col2: a population of tiny lavender platelet cell fragments, 10–20px units gathered into loose cluster 160wide. Row3 col3: floating individual pale gold elongated fibrinogen protein molecules, 10–20px units in cluster 160wide. Row3 col4: fine branching mesh of golden fibrin threads 160wide 100tall, made from same molecules as col3.
Row4 col1: cluster of small violet folded enzyme protein molecules, tangible molecular forms 12–20px units, cluster160wide. Row4 col2: cluster of six white blood cells 35px each with lobed purple nuclei engulfing broken skin fragments. Row4 col3: new epidermal cells 20px each in horizontal patch width120 height70, same cells as row1 col1. Row4 col4: loose newly deposited collagen fibre bundles width150 height100, same fibres as row1 col3.
Biological detail should read at quarter-size. Transparent background throughout, crisp bounded edges, all objects independent with no connecting lines between cells. Render actual anatomical materials, not symbols.
